LanguageData.CQF_HCF_HiveKey_Tip: The target key of a hive building or node pawn that owns the destination groups.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_JoinGroupIndex_Tip: -1 selects the first group that can accept each unit. 0 and higher select one group, ordered by its internal ID. Units and the hive or node must be spawned on the same map.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_ModeGroupIndex_Tip: -1 changes all groups owned by each target. 0 and higher select one group, ordered by its internal ID. An ordinary unit targets its current group.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_InvalidJoinSettings: [CQF/HCF] Joining a group requires a hive or node key and a group index of -1 or greater.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_InvalidModeSettings: [CQF/HCF] Setting a group mode requires a mode and a group index of -1 or greater.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_HiveMissing: [CQF/HCF] No valid hive or node was found for key '{0}'.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_GroupMissing: [CQF/HCF] Target '{0}' has no group matching index {1}.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_InvalidUnit: [CQF/HCF] Target '{0}' is not a valid pawn for joining a group.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_DifferentMap: [CQF/HCF] Unit '{0}' and hive or node '{1}' must be spawned on the same map before joining a group.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_JoinRejected: [CQF/HCF] Unit '{0}' could not join a group belonging to '{1}': {2}
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_UnknownRejection: The group rejected the unit without providing a reason.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_InvalidGroupTarget: [CQF/HCF] Target '{0}' is not a valid hive, node or group member.
LanguageData.CQF_HCF_ModeUnsupported: [CQF/HCF] Group {1} of '{0}' does not support mode '{2}' with its current target.
